SIP::route_status
Description
The
SIP::route_status
command returns the routing status of the current
message. Valid status are:
“unprocessed”
“route found”
“no route found”
“dropped”
“queue full”
“no connection”
“connection closing”
“internal error”
“route found” is based on the SIP RouteTable finding a route. It is
not effected by the proxy’s ability to create a connection, so even if
the server is not listening on the specified address or marked down,
it might still return status as “route found” if the RouteTable is
able to find the route Please
see HighperformancemessageroutingframeworkforIMSprotocolsFS#MessageRoutingFrameworkCommands
for a complete description of route status.
Syntax
SIP
::
route_status
